summary: In dark mode the active workspace row on the Workspaces overview keeps a hard-coded light background, so the row is a light bar with light text; hovering shows the theme colour. No usable merge request exists: the issue fork branch has no commits and the merge request that was opened used the branch name main.

facts.text: shank115 reproduced it with default_admin in dark mode. Cause: tr.active-workspace { background-color: #ebeae4; } in workspaces_ui (workspaces.overview.pcss.css), more specific than the theme table row rule; a @todo there already says to move it to the admin theme.
Three options were proposed: light-dark(#ebeae4, transparent); light-dark with a subtle dark colour; the theme variable --admin-color-bg-item. shank115 leans to the theme variable.

rkoller: the merge request cannot be checked out (branch named main); transparent hides the active state, and options 2 and 3 give about 1.28:1 for the state, below the 3:1 of SC 1.4.11. rkoller suggests a preliminary legibility fix here and the proper visual indication in #3207233.
The issue is Needs review; the lab found no merge request and an empty issue fork branch, so the fix is written in the lab.

open.text: Which approach should the fix take, and is a non-colour indicator for the active state in scope here or only in #3207233?
